clues: This city is in Iran, in the Middle East. It is the capital of Alborz province.
This place has its own special weather. Many trees, rivers, and green plains around it help shape that weather.
People first lived here long ago in the Bronze Age. Old signs of their homes were found at Tepe Khurvin.
Many newcomers choose to live here. After Tehran, it is the most welcoming city for them in the whole country.
It is the third biggest city in its country. Only Tehran and Mashhad are bigger than it.
